blockers.title: After a failed or offline refresh at 200% text the page scrolls sideways and the Aggiorna button goes off the screen, at 320, 360 and even 412 px
blockers.evidence: Measured on pixel-7 and iphone-13 viewports (Chromium). Fresh copy: no overflow at any size. After a failed refresh with signal ('Aggiornamento non riuscito, riprova tra poco. Dati delle 09:00'): scrollWidth 409 at 320 px/200%, 437 at 360/200, 437 at 412/200. The 'Aggiorna le previsioni' button's box is x 296.6-384.6 at 320 px, so only 23 px of it is on the screen, and the screenshot shows no button. Offline with a 30-hour-old copy ('Senza rete. Dati di ieri alle 09:00: potrebbero essere superati'): scrollWidth 352 at 320/200 and 380 at 360/200. The wide element is the header wrapper 'grid gap-1' (src/features/weather/WeatherScreen.tsx:1308). It has an auto track, so StatusLine's min-content sets its width (WeatherScreen.tsx:123-200): the longest word ('Aggiornamento') plus the icon, the 88 px button and rem-scaled padding comes to 397 px. tests/e2e/weather.spec.ts audits sideways scroll only in the fresh state (lines 916-1019). It happens in both areas (Derive and Cabinati).
blockers.reproduction: Throwaway specs in my scratchpad's n2/ (e-offline.spec.ts, f-failed.spec.ts; config pw.config.ts, projects pixel-7 and iphone-13-chromium). By hand: Deriva course, clock Sat 7 Nov 09:00, open Vento, let it download, make the API fail (or go offline), tap Aggiorna, then set the viewport to 320x640 and the html font-size to 200%. Expected: no sideways scroll and the retry button visible beside 'riprova tra poco'. Observed: the page is 409 px wide and the button is off the right edge, at the very moment the message says to try again.
blockers.specRef: docs/design/07_PAGE_CHANGELOG.md P21 Accettazione ('nessuno scorrimento orizzontale a 320 px e 200%'); 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md WX1 adversarial checklist ('no signal', '320 px at 200% text'); docs/VENTO.md 'The screen ... offers Aggiorna'
